raw_retention.offense_pagination_storage: all successfully fetched public pages concatenated with explicit source-page comments

source_rank.usage: Visible provider order normalized across all fetched pages for the position.

Rank.usage: Deterministic position-only projection ranking and list-length-aware percentile input.

cross_source_comparison.projection_consensus_policy: average only comparable position percentiles; never average provider fantasy-point totals
cross_source_comparison.independence_note: Direct provider projections remain distinct evidence. Do not double-count them through another consensus that already includes FFToday.

league_adjustments: Retain projected raw statistics independently of the provider fantasy-point formula.
Do not treat source FPts as Mighty Giants league points.

For QB/RB/WR/TE, derive Mighty Giants core points only from scoring-relevant raw stats comparably projected by active providers; do not impute missing components such as two-point conversions or fumble-loss projections.
Apply six-team replacement level, two fixed QB, two fixed TE and four FLEX slots only during downstream interpretation.
Use current role, injury and competition evidence separately from the projection ranking.
limitations: FFToday does not expose a documented public Projection API in the audited surface.
The HTML parser depends on the public table and official player-link structure.
Custom-scoring views require a logged-in league profile and are intentionally not used.
Projection values are provider estimates and can change materially during training camp and the season.
Derived league-scoring core points intentionally omit non-comparable projected scoring components and are not a complete exact season-point forecast.
